description: Create an outreach sequence. approach "signal": a connection request, then an opener Getcleed writes for each lead from their own signals and two follow-ups (the default, and what the product is for). "simple": four short generic messages. "own": fixed messages you pass, sent to everyone with {{first_name}} and {{company|your team}} filled in (write a fallback after | for company). The sequence is created stopped and empty: nothing is sent until leads are added and start_sequence is confirmed. Does not need LinkedIn connected.

messages.description: For approach "own": the messages in order. The first goes out the day after they accept the connection request.

reviewBeforeSend.description: true: every message waits for an approval before it is sent. false (the product default): messages go out on schedule.

name: create_sequence
title: Create a sequence
